title: About Green Valley Residency
text: Green Valley Residency is a fictional gated apartment community used as demo data for this project. It has 6 residential towers with 480 apartments, built around a central park. Construction of all towers was completed in 2025. The community is managed by the Green Valley Management Office, which handles maintenance, security and resident services.

title: Apartment Types and Sizes
text: Three apartment types are available. The one-bedroom apartment is 650 square feet and includes an open kitchen and one bathroom. The two-bedroom apartment is 1,050 square feet with two bathrooms and a balcony. The three-bedroom apartment is 1,500 square feet with three bathrooms, a servant room and a large balcony facing the park.

title: Prices
text: The one-bedroom apartment costs PKR 9.5 million. The two-bedroom apartment costs PKR 15 million. The three-bedroom apartment costs PKR 22 million. Park-facing units carry a 5 percent premium, and corner units carry a 3 percent premium. Prices exclude government taxes and registration fees.

title: Instalment Payment Plan
text: Buyers can pay in instalments over three years. A 20 percent down payment is due at booking. The remaining amount is split into 12 equal quarterly instalments. Buyers who pay the full amount upfront receive a 7 percent discount.

title: How to Book an Apartment
text: To book an apartment, visit the sales office with the required documents and pay the down payment. The sales team will reserve your chosen unit for 48 hours while the payment clears. After the payment clears, you receive a provisional allotment letter by email within 5 working days.

title: Documents Required for Booking
text: Buyers must provide a copy of their national identity card, two passport-size photographs, and proof of income such as a salary slip or bank statement. Overseas buyers can submit a copy of their passport instead of the identity card. A nominee's identity card copy is also required.

title: Possession and Handover
text: Possession is handed over after at least 50 percent of the total price has been paid. The handover includes a joint inspection of the apartment with a site engineer. Any defects found during inspection are fixed within 30 days at no cost to the buyer.

title: Monthly Maintenance Charges
text: Every resident pays a monthly maintenance charge that covers cleaning of common areas, security staff, lifts and landscaping. The charge is PKR 6,000 per month for one-bedroom, PKR 9,000 for two-bedroom and PKR 12,000 for three-bedroom apartments. It must be paid by the 10th of each month.

title: Late Payment Penalty
text: If an instalment or maintenance charge is paid after the due date, a late fee of 2 percent of the overdue amount is added for each month of delay. If payments are more than 90 days overdue, the management office may suspend access to amenities such as the gym and pool until the account is cleared.

title: Electricity and Power Backup
text: Each apartment has its own electricity meter, and residents pay the electricity bill directly to the power company. During power cuts, a central generator provides backup for lifts, corridor lights and up to 2 kilowatts per apartment. The backup switches on automatically within 30 seconds of an outage.

title: Solar Panels
text: Solar panels on the tower rooftops power the common areas during the day, including corridor lights, water pumps and the clubhouse. This reduces the shared electricity cost, which keeps maintenance charges lower. Residents cannot install private solar panels on the rooftop.

title: Water Supply
text: Water is supplied 24 hours a day from underground tanks that are filled from two deep wells. The water passes through a filtration plant before reaching the apartments. Water tanks are cleaned every six months, and residents are notified a week in advance.

title: Gas Connection
text: Every apartment has a piped natural gas connection for cooking. Gas bills are paid directly to the gas company. Gas cylinders are not allowed inside apartments for safety reasons.

title: Internet and Cable TV
text: Fiber internet is available in every apartment through two licensed providers. Residents choose a provider and sign their own contract. Speeds of up to 200 Mbps are available. Free Wi-Fi is provided in the clubhouse and the lobby of each tower.

title: Security
text: The community has a single main gate with guards on duty 24 hours a day. CCTV cameras cover the gate, parking areas, lobbies and the park. Visitors must show identification at the gate and are only allowed in after a resident confirms the visit through the intercom.

title: Parking
text: Each apartment comes with one covered parking space in the basement. Three-bedroom apartments get two parking spaces. Additional parking spaces can be rented for PKR 2,000 per month, subject to availability. Visitor parking is available near the main gate for up to 4 hours.

title: Amenities
text: Residents have access to a gym, a swimming pool, a clubhouse, a jogging track around the park, a mosque and a small grocery store. The gym opens from 6 am to 11 pm. The swimming pool has separate timings for families and is closed on Mondays for cleaning.

title: Children's Play Area and School
text: A fenced children's play area with swings and slides is located in the central park. A daycare centre operates inside the clubhouse from 8 am to 5 pm on weekdays. The nearest primary school is a 5-minute walk from the main gate.

title: Pet Policy
text: Small pets such as cats, birds and small dogs are allowed in apartments. Pets must be registered with the management office and vaccinated. Dogs must be kept on a leash in all common areas and are not allowed in the pool area or the children's play area. Owners must clean up after their pets.

title: Renting Out Your Apartment
text: Owners may rent out their apartments to tenants. The owner must submit a copy of the rental agreement and the tenant's identity card to the management office before the tenant moves in. Short-term holiday rentals of less than one month are not permitted. The owner remains responsible for maintenance charges.

title: Transfer of Ownership
text: An apartment can be sold or transferred to another person after all dues are cleared. Both the seller and buyer must visit the management office with their identity cards. A transfer fee of 1 percent of the apartment price is charged. The transfer is processed within 10 working days.

title: Cancellation and Refund
text: A buyer who cancels a booking before possession receives a refund of the amount paid minus a 10 percent deduction. Refunds are paid within 90 days of the cancellation request. No refund is available after possession has been handed over; the apartment must be sold through a transfer instead.

title: Renovation and Alterations
text: Residents may renovate the interior of their apartment after submitting a written plan to the management office. Structural changes, such as removing walls or columns, are strictly prohibited. Noisy work is allowed only between 10 am and 6 pm, Monday to Saturday.

title: Moving In and Moving Out
text: Residents must book the service lift at least 48 hours before moving in or out. Moving is allowed between 9 am and 7 pm. A refundable deposit of PKR 10,000 is taken to cover any damage to common areas during the move.

title: Waste Collection and Recycling
text: Garbage is collected from every floor each morning between 8 am and 10 am. Residents should leave bags in the bins near the lifts. Separate bins for paper, plastic and glass are placed in each basement for recycling.

title: Complaints and Repairs
text: Residents can report a problem, such as a water leak or a broken light, through the resident app or by calling the management office. Urgent issues like leaks are attended within 4 hours. Routine requests are handled within 3 working days.

title: Management Office Hours and Contact
text: The management office is located on the ground floor of Tower A. It is open from 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday. Outside office hours, residents can contact the security control room, which operates 24 hours a day.

title: Fire Safety and Emergencies
text: Every floor has fire extinguishers, smoke detectors and an emergency exit staircase. Fire drills are held twice a year. In case of fire, residents should use the stairs, not the lifts, and gather at the assembly point in the central park.

title: Guests and Visitors
text: Guests are welcome at any time, but must register at the main gate. Guests staying overnight for more than three nights must be reported to the management office. Guests may use the gym and pool only when accompanied by a resident.

title: Shuttle and Transport
text: A free shuttle bus runs every 30 minutes between the community and the nearest metro station from 7 am to 10 pm. Ride-hailing pickups are allowed at the main gate drop-off point.

title: Community Events
text: The management office organises community events, including a monthly farmers' market in the park, sports tournaments and celebrations on public holidays. Event announcements are posted in the resident app and on lobby notice boards.
